caption:
A simple 2-minute budget check. 🧮

Add up rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, insurance, transport and minimum debt payments.

Divide by your take-home pay.

If essentials take over about 55%, that's your sign to look for the biggest bill to trim first.

What percent are your essentials?
